# Exercise 1 answer script
# Expected output variables: cityA, cityB

# ===== DO NOT EDIT: LOCAL TEST FALLBACK START =====
if (!exists("cityA")) cityA <- 10000
if (!exists("cityB")) cityB <- 20000
# ===== DO NOT EDIT: LOCAL TEST FALLBACK END =====

# ===== YOUR SOLUTION START =====
for (year in 1:5) {
  moveA <- 0.01 * cityA
  moveB <- 0.02 * cityB
  cityA <- cityA - moveA + moveB
  cityB <- cityB + moveA - moveB
}
# ===== YOUR SOLUTION END =====
